The offline app bundles:

- Firebase JavaScript SDK 9.23.0 (Firebase app, auth, and Firestore compat builds).
  Licensed under Apache-2.0; see FIREBASE-LICENSE.txt.
- SheetJS Community Edition 0.18.5.
  Licensed under Apache-2.0; see SHEETJS-LICENSE.txt.
- Capacitor Filesystem and Share plugins are installed from npm and built into
  the Android application. Both are MIT-licensed.
